verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents an `ai_query` parameter for extracting information from a page using AI, plus `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction as an alternative to CSS/XPath `extract_rules`. This directly matches the story of natural-language extraction instead of writing selectors. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the structured output schema and format of `ai_extract_rules`, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors

citations.quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
Choose AI extraction when the desired field is semantic or the structure is irregular.
